skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the interaction between business and environment.
Identify and analyze corporate environmental strategies, including proactive environmental strategies.
Analyze corporate social responsibility and sustainable business practices.
Understand and analyze environmental technologies and techniques for improving environmental quality.
Apply knowledge to analyze and discuss corporate environmental strategies and sustainable business practices.
Develop and demonstrate the ability to work in groups through research, information gathering, and presentation.
Develop and demonstrate the ability to present research findings effectively.
Develop critical thinking skills through case studies and discussions.
Understand and analyze environmental compliance standards and regulations.
Understand and analyze environmental auditing techniques and practices.
Understand and analyze sustainability reporting practices.
